t: Time 3183P black flexible cable is engineered for pond pumps and other outdoor cabling applications. This 10m coil features a robust 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The durable rubber sheath resists weather, UV exposure and moisture degradation, operating reliably from -35°C to 60°C for extended outdoor use. The 1.5mm² conductor area with 30 strands per core delivers dependable current handling and superior flexibility for pond installations, garden equipment and external electrical systems.
b: Suitable for Pond Pumps & Other Outdoor Cabling
